Title: the new 11-caps (Fakir al Sidi, what's he good for?), includes deck idea

Messages.Author: Malone
Messages.Body:
The new star 11-cap is the startling Mistress Fanchion, n'est-ce pas?

Despite the existence of Justicar Retribution (burn inherent 3-
bleeders) I think +2 bleed is a better bonus than +1 fu +1 bar, but no
doubt arguments to the contrary could be made, especially on a case-by-
case basis.

The 'you can't contest my title' specials on the Rafael and Hardestadt
seem pretty limp, although they are the two most likely to encounter
their rival Inner Circle member.

Lutz's special is solid; Adana's is too, I guess, although pretty
tame.

Josef's special is garbage, and he would almost give Don Giovanni some
competition for WORST 11-CAP if not for the 4 votes, which it's hard
to sneeze at.

But Fakir??? No votes; a press each combat (yaaaawwwn...); a firm but
expensive, strictly defensive political special; what's he got that's
anywhere worth 11? I understand he can do some stuff, but what can he
do that somebody cheaper can't do as well or better?

The only thing I've managed to think of is Enkil Cog + Veles Hunt +
Redline. But wouldn't Stanislava do that better? Maybe Fakir can put
together a better support crypt for such a deck than Stanislava could,
and some Anarch tricks plus Awe and Voter Cap might outweigh the
benefit of Stanislava's inherent votes.

He still costs 11 pool, at least 3 turns to bring out, has no good
bounce, and only acts once a turn. If I have to play a card to make my
2-cap have his special (effectively) for bleeding, that's not a bad
trade for me. If you go first and I go last (your pred) I can get out
4 1-caps in turn 1, 2 more in turn two (effective management), and
have bled you for (8(turn 2) + 12(turn 3)) 20 with computer hackings

do. Sure, that won't happen a lot and there are other factors involved
than just that, but even 1 successful bleed with Belle may be worth
the 2-cap, the action, and the card, imho.
Efficiency is not the calling card of 11-caps.

Messages.Author: jwjbw...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


I have a weenie bleed deck too. I know weenies have their
advantages. But 11 caps have their uses too, and I thought we were
comparing them.

One of my favorite tricks is to design a deck around a single 10 or 11
cap, and surround him with 1 cap weenies. That way, I can bring out
minions quickly, without necessarily having any delay in my main
minion.

I'm inclined to think that Enkil Cog + Animalism untap would work well
with him.

Seems to me that, through a combination of Confusion of the Eye and
Wrong and Crosswise, he could combine substantial bleed reduction with
powerful vote defense. By playing both cards, he could either reduce
a bleed by 3, or have in total 8 votes against a referendum in which
all votes of the acting vampire are cancelled.

I like the Wrong and Crosswise + Confusion of the Eye combo. I've
mentioned the lack of good bounce, but also he has only 3 pts of out-
of-clan disciplines. His special sucks really hard. If he had a better
capacity for multi-acting, the +1 stealth would be a bigger deal.
Basic tha or for would be good enough. If you want to use him as a
blocker, he has no AUS for Eagle's sight. For God's sake, he could at
least have CEL for Psyche!! If you can make a good deck from him, more
power to you. I think that there are a lot better 10/11 caps from this
set.

I'll give a small run-down.

Adana de Sforza [KoT:PB2]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Brujah
Group: 4
Capacity: 11
Discipline: aus CEL OBF POT PRE PRO
Camarilla Brujah Inner Circle: Combat cards cost Adana 1 less blood.
+2 bleed.

Good for:
S&B- Bleed with Flurry at CEL and untap, Enkil Cog, Bleed on their
turn and crank it up with Old Friends or Air of Elation. Free Majesty
and Resist the Earth's Grasp? Yes, please!
Combat- -1 cost for any combat card. Rush, free Resist the Earth's
Grasp, TS, grapple, free pushing the limit, free blur. Decapitate for
1. Free Street Cred.
Down side
-no easily accessible bounce
-minimal bloat
-little damage prevention

Alonso Petrodon [KoT:V]
Cardtype: Vampire

Clan: Nosferatu
Group: 5
Capacity: 10

Discipline: for tha ANI DOM OBF POT
Camarilla Nosferatu Justicar: When Alonso bleeds successfully, each
anarch controlled by the target takes 1 unpreventable damage. +1
bleed.

Good for:
-multi-act via Rutor's, freak drive, Warsaw Station
-Big bleeds
-Bloat with Govern
-Beat down w/prevention
-Big D to the OM for bounce

Bad
-special is very match-up dependent
-no cross table blocking with Eagle's sight

The Ankou has been discussed in other posts

Fakir al Sidi [KoT:V]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Gangrel
Group: 4
Capacity: 11
Discipline: abo ANI FOR PRE PRO THA
Independent: Before votes are cast, Fakir may burn 3 blood to cause
the referendum of a political action to fail. He gets an optional
press each combat. +1 bleed. +1 strength.

Hey, isn't this the guy we were talking about in the first place? ;P
Good for:
-All kinds of nasty combat
-Multi-Acting with Rutor's
-Social Charm bleed, Enkil Cog, Freak Drive, bleed on their turn with
Social Charm for another pool

Bad:
-Weak bounce
-11 cap with no votes? Weak sauce.

There are lots of 7+ cap vamps with good specials, that's just a few.

Messages.Author: Malone

> With a single card, Confusion, he gets 3 bleed at +2 stealth (from a

So do many or most of the Inner Circle members, with a card called
Lost In Crowds. OK, LIC is not burnable if the stealth isn't needed.
Still, bleed for 3 at 2 stealth with a single card is nothing special
in an 11 cap.

> If he hopes to
> pump his bleeds higher -- then his ability to disrupt his prey's hand
> at random starts to seem less wimpy.

A random discard is roughly as likely to make your prey draw Archon
Investigation as to discard it. In general, a random discard will be
nearly neutral on any deck that doesn't have to carefully groom for
specific combos and isn't in danger of depleting its library.

Mistress Fanchon does win. However, i think Fakir's ability to do 4
damage a fight without cards is pretty damn strong (see Matata). He's
also got a perma-presss with superor Thaumatergy, which is incerdibly
dangerous, although not nearly as awesome as the "Don't hunt while
empty" text on Lambach basic. He also shares +1 bleed +1 strength with
Saulot, and while Saulot has other advantages they both make really
solid big-caps. They both have THA FOR, too, and Repulsion has a
presence outferior...hmm...anyway, no access to good bounce hurts, but
he can totally hose a vote for 3 blood, while tapped if necessary, so
political decks have to be wary when lunging at him. Sure, it's
expensive, but if we're talking 3 blood from a vampire or 3-5 pool
from a KRC, Parity Shift or Reckless AG (a nasty vote he can call)
it's probably worth it. I guess he can play Lost in translation, but
if you're spending that kind of pool you better be playing Entrenching/
Restoration and Freak Drive, which is card intensive.

See, but I think he is. Which is why I'm making the case. In the thread
about the worst 11 cap in the game. Or at least certainly the worst IC
member (the worst 11 cap in general probably gets to be one of the
Independents, like the Giovanni guy or Ur Shugli or someone). Heck, I
have a deck in the TWDA that uses a couple Harrods (Obf/Pot/Pre vote
deck that fills up on voter cap). And I *still* think he is the worst
IC. Gwendolyn is no super prize, but at least when she was printed, she
had some cache as the only vampire in the game with POT/FOR, and she can
both bleed like crazy and kill like crazy (POT/FOR/CEL/tha = unstoppable
destruction in combat). Harrod doesn't mesh well with his clan (he is
the only Nosferatu in his group range with CEL, very few Nosferatu in
the G1-3 range have even cel; there is very little pre with the group
range), can generally be replaced by someone more effective in pretty
much any situation you'd want to use him. And his special ability is
just a slap in the face. Yeah, he can get super tooled up with a
Helicopter and Warsaw Station and Lost in Translation and whatever, but
I'd rather put the effort into Sheldon (who can bounce more effectively
with Telepathic Misdirection) who can also play Parity Shift. Or, well,
pretty much anyone else.

> PB:LA?!

Josef von Bauren
Clan: Nosferatu (group 4)
Capacity: 11
Disciplines: ANI DEM OBF POT ****You may use a discard phase action to
discard a card at random from your predator or prey's hand.**** +1
bleed. +1 stealth.

Powerbase: Los Angeles
Type: Master
Master: unique location.
*****Tap during your discard phase to gain a discard phase action.
*****If you use that discard phase action to discard a card that
requires an anarch or a card that makes a vampire an anarch, you may
untap a ready anarch. Any anarch controlled by another Methuselah may
steal this location for his or her controller as a (D) action

Feline Saboteur
Type: Action
Requires: Animalism & Obfuscate
[ani][obf] (D) Choose any Methuselah. The chosen Methuselah discards 1
card at random from his or her hand.
[ANI][OBF] As [ani][obf] above, and the chosen Methuselah burns the
top 4 cards of his or her library as well.

Rarity: BL:U2

So with Josef you could play a Feline Saboteur (making your prey lose
6 cards) then use his special, then use Powerbase L.A to use his
special again. So that is eight cards. So at the very worst with
your prey playing ZERO cards you have decked your prey on Round 13
which sounds bad, but having looked at JOL and seen that most players
will cycle 5 cards between their untap phases at minimum. That puts
your prey out of the game at Turn 10. That is one vampires by himself
acting once per turn. If you start adding Petra/Greensleeves/Jara
Drory/Zelios/Lukas you have a potent political base to fend off
political decks. You could add Absimillards Army to increase the burn
rate.

You could add Petrodon so if you prey goes anarch to steal the
Powerbase you can punish him with Petrodon's special.
